title: Planned full-scale rare-earth mud test
basis: Public reporting (Feb 2026): a full-scale test is planned for February 2027 at about 350 t of sediment per day.
expect: Chikyu leaving Shimizu for the Minamitorishima area and holding one spot over 5,500 m or deeper for weeks: it would show here as a station event inside the Japanese EEZ.
